en.t: Li Shimin, the future Emperor Taizong of Tang, ambushes and kills his rival brothers Li Yuanji and Li Jiancheng in the Xuanwu Gate Incident
en.s: Emperor Taizong of Tang (28 January 598 – 10 July 649), previously Prince of Qin, personal name Li Shimin, was the second emperor of the Tang dynasty of China, ruling from 626 to 649. He is traditionally regarded as a co-founder of the dynasty for his role in encouraging his father Li Yuan (Emperor Gaozu) to rebel against the Sui dynasty at Jinyang in 617.

zh.t: 未来的唐太宗李世民在玄武门之变中伏击并杀死政敌兄弟李元吉和李建成
zh.s: 唐太宗（598年1月28日—649年7月10日），此前封秦王，名李世民，是中国唐朝第二位皇帝，在位时间为626年至649年。传统上，人们认为他与父亲李渊（唐高祖）于617年在晋阳起兵反隋、促成唐朝建立，因此也被视为唐朝的共同奠基者。

en.s: The Xuanwu Gate Incident was a palace coup for the throne of the Tang dynasty on 2 July 626. During the incident, Prince Li Shimin (Prince of Qin) and his followers assassinated his brothers Crown Prince Li Jiancheng and Prince Li Yuanji (Prince of Qi). Li Shimin took control and set up an ambush at Xuanwu Gate, the northern gate leading to the Palace City within the imperial capital Chang'an.

zh.s: 玄武门之变是626年7月2日为争夺唐朝皇位而发动的一场宫廷政变。秦王李世民和追随者在事件中刺杀了兄长、太子李建成和齐王李元吉。李世民随后掌控局势，并在玄武门设下伏兵。玄武门是长安皇城宫城的北门。

en.s: The Battle of Brissarthe was fought on 2 July 866, between the West Franks and a joint Breton-Viking army near Brissarthe, Neustria. It was marked by the death of Robert the Strong, the Neustrian margrave, and Ranulf I, the duke of Aquitaine, and an ancestor of all the kings of France from 987 to 1848.

zh.s: 布里萨尔特战役于866年7月2日发生在纽斯特里亚的布里萨尔特附近，交战双方是西法兰克人和布列塔尼—维京联军。纽斯特里亚边侯罗贝尔·勒·福尔和阿基坦公爵兰努夫一世在战斗中阵亡；兰努夫一世是987至1848年间所有法国国王的祖先。

en.s: The siege of Crema was a siege of the town of Crema, Lombardy by the Holy Roman Empire from 2 July 1159 to 25 January 1160. The Cremaschi attempted to defend their city from the Germans, but were eventually defeated by Frederick Barbarossa's men. Frederick seized Milan in 1162, shortly after he took Crema.

zh.s: 1159年7月2日至1160年1月25日，神圣罗马帝国围攻伦巴第的克雷马城。克雷马居民试图抵御德军，最终仍被腓特烈·巴巴罗萨的军队击败。腓特烈在攻占克雷马后不久，于1162年夺取米兰。

en.s: The siege of La Roche-aux-Moines was an engagement of the Anglo-French War (1213-1214). King John of England besieged the castle but had to retreat in the face of King Philip Augustus' son, Prince Louis. King John did not want to engage the French army in battle and had opted for a diversionary approach.

zh.s: 拉罗什欧莫因围城战是1213至1214年英法战争中的一场交战。英王约翰围攻城堡，但面对法王腓力·奥古斯都之子路易亲王时被迫撤退。约翰不愿与法军正面交战，因此选择了迂回策略。

en.s: The Battle of Göllheim was fought on 2 July 1298 between the forces of duke Albert I of Habsburg (German: Albrecht) and king Adolf of Nassau following the unilateral decision of the prince electors, without any formal election, to dethrone Adolf and proclaim Albert as king. Adolf died in the battle.

zh.s: 格尔海姆战役于1298年7月2日爆发，交战双方是哈布斯堡公爵阿尔布雷希特一世与拿骚国王阿道夫的军队。此前，选帝侯未经正式选举便单方面决定废黜阿道夫并拥立阿尔布雷希特为王。阿道夫在战斗中阵亡。

en.s: The Battle of Bulgnéville was fought on 2 July 1431. The battle was fought between two cousins, René I d'Anjou and Antoine de Vaudémont, over partition of the Duchy of Lorraine after the death of Duke Charles II. Although René was defeated and captured, the result was reversed by diplomatic means in the years following.

zh.s: 布尔涅维尔战役于1431年7月2日爆发。安茹的勒内一世与沃德蒙的安托万两位堂兄弟为洛林公国的分割问题交战，此前洛林公爵查理二世去世。勒内战败被俘，但此后几年通过外交手段扭转了战局结果。

en.s: The Battle of Yamazaki (山崎の戦い, Yamazaki no tatakai) was fought in 1582 in Yamazaki, Japan, located in current-day Kyoto Prefecture. This battle is sometimes referred to as the Battle of Mt. Tennō (天王山の戦い Tennō-zan no tatakai). In the Honnō-ji Incident, Akechi Mitsuhide, a retainer of Oda Nobunaga, attacked Nobunaga as he rested in Honnō-ji, and forced him to commit seppuku.

zh.s: 山崎之战（日语：山崎の戦い，Yamazaki no tatakai）于1582年在日本山崎发生，该地现属京都府。此战有时也称天王山之战（日语：天王山の戦い，Tennō-zan no tatakai）。本能寺之变期间，织田信长的家臣明智光秀袭击了在本能寺休息的信长，迫使他自尽。

en.s: The Capture of Delfzijl took place during the Eighty Years' War and the Anglo–Spanish War by a Dutch and English army led by Maurice of Orange. The siege commenced on the 26 June and lasted when the Spanish troops surrendered the city of Delfzijl on 2 July 1591.

zh.s: 代尔夫宰尔围城战发生于八十年战争和英西战争期间。莫里斯·奥兰治亲王率领荷英联军围攻该城，围城从6月26日开始，西班牙守军于1591年7月2日投降。

en.s: The siege of Hatvan was a siege that took place in 1594. The German army, under the command of Christoph von Teuffenbach, Governor of Styria of the Holy Roman Empire, was defeated and the siege was lifted before Hatvan, which they besieged between 20 April and 2 July 1594.

zh.s: 豪特万围城战发生于1594年。神圣罗马帝国施蒂利亚总督克里斯托夫·冯·托伊芬巴赫率领的德军战败，在豪特万城外解除围城。德军自4月20日起围城，至1594年7月2日撤围。

en.s: The Battle of Nieuwpoort (also known as the Battle of the Dunes) was fought on 2 July 1600 during the Eighty Years War and the Anglo-Spanish war in the dunes near Nieuwpoort. A Dutch army met a Spanish force head-on which, although their left flank nearly broke, were able to assail them with both infantry and cavalry. The Spanish gradually scattered in all directions and left their guns on the field.

zh.s: 纽波特战役又称沙丘战役，于1600年7月2日爆发，是八十年战争和英西战争中的一场战役，战场位于纽波特附近的沙丘。荷军与西班牙军正面交锋。西军左翼一度几乎崩溃，但随后以步兵和骑兵发动攻击。西班牙军逐渐四散溃退，并将火炮留在战场上。

en.s: The siege of Rheinberg was a 21-day siege led by Frederick Henry, the then Prince of Orange. The siege resulted in a Dutch victory, with the last major Spanish-controlled city near the Rhine falling into Dutch hands.

en.s: The Battle of Marston Moor was fought on 2 July 1644, during the First English Civil War of 1642–1646. The combined forces of the English Parliamentarians under Lord Fairfax and the Earl of Manchester and the Scottish Covenanters under the Earl of Leven defeated the Royalists commanded by Prince Rupert of the Rhine and the Marquess of Newcastle. During the summer of 1644, the Covenanters and Parliamentarians had been besieging York, which was defended by the Marquess of Newcastle. Rupert had gathered an army which marched through the northwest of England, gathering reinforcements and fresh recruits on the way, and across the Pennines to relieve the city.

zh.s: 马斯顿荒原战役发生于1644年7月2日，是1642至1646年第一次英国内战中的一场战役。费尔法克斯勋爵和曼彻斯特伯爵率领的英国议会军，与莱文伯爵率领的苏格兰圣约派联军，击败了由莱茵河的鲁珀特亲王和纽卡斯尔侯爵指挥的保王党军。1644年夏，圣约派和议会军一直围困由纽卡斯尔侯爵守卫的约克。鲁珀特集结军队，从英格兰西北部行军，一路补充援军和新兵，再越过奔宁山脉前去解围。

en.s: The Battle of Alford was an engagement of the Wars of the Three Kingdoms, which took place near the village of Alford, Aberdeenshire, Scotland, on 2 July 1645. The battlefield is included in the Inventory of Historic Battlefields in Scotland and protected by Historic Scotland under the Historic Environment (Amendment) Act 2011. Having defeated Colonel Hurry at Auldearn, the Marquis of Montrose continued his raiding campaign in the Highlands. Fearing that Montrose intended to attack Aberdeen again, Major-General William Baillie led the Covenanter army to cut him off.

zh.s: 阿尔福德战役是三王国战争中的一场交战，1645年7月2日发生在苏格兰阿伯丁郡阿尔福德村附近。战场被列入苏格兰历史战场名录，并依据《2011年历史环境（修订）法》受到苏格兰历史环境局保护。蒙特罗斯侯爵在奥尔迪恩击败赫里上校后，继续在高地地区发动突袭。少将威廉·贝利担心蒙特罗斯会再次进攻阿伯丁，于是率领圣约派军队前去拦截。

en.t: Battle of the Faubourg St Antoine
en.s: The Battle of the Faubourg Saint Antoine occurred on 2 July 1652 during the Fronde rebellion in France. It is named after the Faubourg Saint-Antoine, a district near the Bastille in the east of Paris, where the battle took place.

zh.s: 圣安托万郊区战役发生于1652年7月2日，是法国投石党运动期间的一场战斗。战役以圣安托万郊区命名，战斗发生在巴黎东部、巴士底狱附近的这一地区。

en.s: The Battle of Landguard Fort or the Attack on Landguard Fort was a battle towards the end of the Second Anglo-Dutch War on 2 July 1667 where a Dutch force attacked Landguard Fort near Felixstowe. It was intended to clear the way for an attack on the English Royal naval anchorage at Harwich. After repeated attempts the Dutch attack planned by Michiel de Ruyter was repelled and as a result the planned attack on Harwich was abandoned. It was one of the last battles of the war in Europe before the Treaty of Breda was signed.

zh.s: 兰德加德堡战役又称兰德加德堡进攻战，发生于1667年7月2日，是第二次英荷战争末期的一场战役。荷兰军队进攻费利克斯托附近的兰德加德堡，意在为进攻英国皇家海军在哈里奇的锚地扫清道路。米希尔·德·鲁伊特策划的荷军多次进攻均被击退，原定的哈里奇进攻也因此取消。这是布雷达条约签订前欧洲战场上的最后几场战役之一。

en.s: The battle of Staphorst was a battle during the Franco-Dutch War, between troops led by John Maurice, Prince of Nassau-Siegen and Hans Willem van Aylva against the troops led by Christoph Bernhard von Galen, the battle resulted in a Dutch victory and led to the town being captured by Dutch forces. As a result of this battle, the Dutch troops would fight another battle, near Zwartsluis on 20 July, but without success.

zh.s: 斯塔普霍斯特战役是法荷战争期间的一场战斗。纳骚-锡根亲王约翰·莫里斯和汉斯·威廉·范·艾尔瓦率军对阵克里斯托夫·伯恩哈德·冯·加伦指挥的部队。荷军获胜，并占领了该镇。此战之后，荷军于7月20日在兹瓦特斯勒伊斯附近再次交战，但未能取胜。

en.s: The Battle of Køge Bay was a naval battle between Denmark-Norway and Sweden that took place in the bay off of Køge 1–2 July 1677 during the Scanian War. The battle was a major success for Admiral Niels Juel after his previous victory one month earlier at the Battle of Møn, and is regarded as the greatest victory in Danish naval history.

zh.s: 1677年7月1日至2日，丹麦—挪威与瑞典在斯堪尼亚战争期间于科厄附近海湾爆发海战。尼尔斯·朱尔海军上将率军取得重大胜利，此前一个月他刚在蒙岛海战中获胜。这场战役被视为丹麦海军史上最重大的胜利。

en.s: The Battle of Schellenberg, also known as the Battle of Donauwörth, was fought on 2 July 1704 during the War of the Spanish Succession. The engagement was part of the Duke of Marlborough's campaign to save the Habsburg capital of Vienna from a threatened advance by King Louis XIV's Franco-Bavarian forces ranged in southern Germany. Marlborough had commenced his 250-mile (400 km) march from Bedburg, near Cologne, on 19 May; within five weeks he had linked his forces with those of the Margrave of Baden, before continuing on to the river Danube.

zh.s: 谢伦贝格战役又称多瑙沃特战役，发生于1704年7月2日，是西班牙王位继承战争中的一场战役。此役属于马尔伯勒公爵的军事行动，目的是阻止路易十四的法巴联军从德国南部推进，威胁哈布斯堡王朝首都维也纳。5月19日，马尔伯勒从科隆附近的贝德堡出发，率军行进约250英里（400公里）；五周内，他与巴登藩侯的部队会合，随后继续向多瑙河进军。

en.s: The Tabarka Expedition was a French military campaign to seize the island of Tabarka from Beylik of Tunis. The campaign ended in a fiasco for the French troops who suffered an ambush and their leader was captured. During the first half of the 18th century, the French government and the Genoese Lomellini family, who owned Tabarka, held several negotiations to cede control of Tabarka island to the French.

zh.s: 塔巴卡远征是法国为从突尼斯贝伊国手中夺取塔巴卡岛而发动的军事行动。行动以法军惨败告终，法军遭伏击，指挥官也被俘。18世纪上半叶，法国政府与拥有塔巴卡岛的热那亚洛梅利尼家族曾多次谈判，商议将该岛控制权移交给法国。

en.s: On July 2, 1747, Marshal Maurice de Saxe’s French army defeated an Allied army led by the Duke of Cumberland at Lauffeld, in present-day Belgium, during the War of the Austrian Succession.

en.s: The Siege of Olomouc took place in 1758 when a Prussian army led by Frederick the Great besieged the Austrian city of Olmütz (now Olomouc, Czech Republic) during the Prussian invasion of Moravia in the Third Silesian War (Seven Years' War). The attempt stalled as the besiegers faced stronger resistance than Frederick had expected.

zh.s: 1758年，腓特烈大帝率领普鲁士军队围攻奥地利城市奥尔米茨（今捷克奥洛穆茨），这是普鲁士在第三次西里西亚战争（七年战争）期间入侵摩拉维亚的一部分。围城未能奏效，围城军遭遇的抵抗比腓特烈预想的更为顽强。

en.s: The Lee Resolution, also known as "The Resolution for Independence", was the formal assertion passed by the Second Continental Congress on July 2, 1776, resolving that the Thirteen Colonies (then referred to as the United Colonies) were "free and independent States" and separate from the British Empire. This created what became the United States. News of the act was published that evening in The Pennsylvania Evening Post and the following day in The Pennsylvania Gazette.

zh.s: 李决议又称《独立决议》，是第二届大陆会议于1776年7月2日通过的正式声明，宣布十三个殖民地（当时称“联合殖民地”）是脱离大英帝国的“自由独立国家”。这一决议促成了后来美国的建立。当天傍晚，《宾夕法尼亚晚报》刊登了决议消息，次日《宾夕法尼亚公报》也予以报道。

en.s: Battle of Miserere occurred during the second British invasion of the Río de la Plata between the British troops at the command of John Whitelocke, and the Spanish forces commanded by Santiago de Liniers. The confrontation took place on 2 July 1807 in the current Miserere square, Balvanera neighborhood, Buenos Aires.

zh.s: 米塞雷雷战役发生于英国第二次入侵拉普拉塔河期间。约翰·怀特洛克指挥的英军与圣地亚哥·德·利尼尔斯指挥的西班牙军队交战。战斗于1807年7月2日在布宜诺斯艾利斯巴尔瓦内拉区现今的米塞雷雷广场一带发生。

en.s: The siege of Kolberg (also spelled Colberg or Kołobrzeg) took place from March to 2 July 1807 during the War of the Fourth Coalition, part of the Napoleonic Wars. An army of the First French Empire and several foreign troops (including Polish insurgents) of France besieged the fortified town of Kolberg, the only remaining Prussian-held fortress in the Province of Pomerania.

zh.s: 科尔贝格围城战（又拼作科尔贝格或科沃布热格）从1807年3月持续至7月2日，是第四次反法同盟战争（拿破仑战争的一部分）期间的一场战役。法兰西第一帝国军队及数支外国部队（包括波兰起义军）围攻科尔贝格要塞。该城是波美拉尼亚省最后一座仍由普鲁士控制的要塞。

en.s: The Battle of Apóstoles was an encounter between the Luso-Brazilian forces under Francisco das Chagas Santos and the Artiguist forces led by Andrés Guazurary, popularly known as Andresito, in Apóstoles. Brazilian general Chagas Santos had attacked the territory of the Misiones, conquering and destroying many villages. He then turned to the Headquarters of Andresito, Apósteles. The artiguist commander awaited him, inflicting heavy losses on the Portuguese and forcing them to retreat.

zh.s: 阿波斯托莱斯战役发生在阿波斯托莱斯，交战双方是弗朗西斯科·达斯·沙加斯·桑托斯率领的葡巴联军，以及安德烈斯·瓜苏拉里（人称安德雷西托）率领的阿蒂加斯派军队。巴西将军沙加斯·桑托斯此前攻入米西奥内斯地区，征服并摧毁了许多村庄，随后转向安德雷西托位于阿波斯托莱斯的总部。阿蒂加斯派指挥官严阵以待，给葡萄牙军队造成重大损失，迫使其撤退。

en.s: The siege of Comayagua was a military engagement during the Honduran-Salvadoran War of 1845 in which Salvadoran forces under the command of José Trinidad Cabañas laid siege to the Honduran capital of Comayagua General Cabañas invaded the territory of Honduras in the last days of May, with a force of between 1,400 and 1,600 soldiers, and without encountering difficulty he reached Comayagua, then capital of that Republic; but having been attacked by the forces under the command of General Guardiola numbering 400 soldiers, the Salvadorans suffered a defeat, and many of them were immolated without mercy to the wrath of the victor.

zh.s: 科马亚瓜围城战是1845年洪都拉斯—萨尔瓦多战争期间的一场军事交战。何塞·特立尼达·卡瓦尼亚斯指挥萨尔瓦多军队围攻洪都拉斯首都科马亚瓜。5月下旬，卡瓦尼亚斯将军率1,400至1,600名士兵入侵洪都拉斯，很快抵达当时的共和国首都科马亚瓜。但瓜迪奥拉将军指挥的400名士兵发起进攻，萨尔瓦多军战败，许多人惨遭胜方杀害。

en.s: The Battle of Hoke's Run, also known as the Battle of Falling Waters or Hainesville, took place on July 2, 1861, in Berkeley County, Virginia (now West Virginia) as part of the Manassas Campaign of the American Civil War. Notable as an early engagement of Confederate Colonel Thomas J. Jackson and his Brigade of Virginia Volunteers, nineteen days before their famous nickname would originate, this brief skirmish was hailed by both sides as a stern lesson to the other. Acting precisely upon the orders of a superior officer about how to operate in the face of superior numbers, Jackson's forces resisted General Robert Patterson's Union forces briefly and then slowly retreated over several miles.

zh.s: 霍克斯河战役又称福林沃特斯战役或海恩斯维尔战役，发生于1861年7月2日，地点在弗吉尼亚州伯克利县（今西弗吉尼亚州），是美国内战马纳萨斯战役行动的一部分。这是南方邦联上校托马斯·J·杰克逊及其弗吉尼亚志愿军旅早期参与的一场交战，距他们后来获得著名绰号还有19天。这场短暂的小规模战斗被双方都视为给对方的严厉教训。杰克逊的部队严格按照上级关于如何面对人数优势敌军的命令行事，短暂抵挡罗伯特·帕特森将军率领的联邦军后，逐步撤退数英里。

en.s: Little Round Top is the smaller of two rocky hills south of Gettysburg, Pennsylvania—the companion to the adjacent, taller hill named Big Round Top. en.s: Devil's Den is a boulder-strewn hill on the south end of Houck's Ridge at Gettysburg Battlefield, used by artillery and sharpshooters on the second day of the 1863 Battle of Gettysburg during the American Civil War. zh.s: 魔鬼巢穴是葛底斯堡战场霍克岭南端一处布满巨石的山丘。美国内战期间，1863年葛底斯堡战役第二天，炮兵和神枪手曾在此作战。自纪念协会时期起，这里就成为旅游景点；部分巨石已被游客踩踏磨损。景区内有许多大炮、纪念物和步道，还有一座横跨两块巨石的桥。

en.t: The U.S. Congress passes the Sherman Antitrust Act
en.s: The Sherman Antitrust Act (26 Stat. 209, 15 U.S.C. §§ 1–7) is a United States antitrust law which prescribes the rule of free competition among those engaged in commerce and consequently prohibits unfair monopolies. It was passed by Congress in 1890 and is named for Senator John Sherman, its principal author. The Sherman Act broadly prohibits 1) anticompetitive agreements and 2) unilateral conduct that monopolizes or attempts to monopolize the relevant market.

zh.t: 美国国会通过《谢尔曼反垄断法》
zh.s: 《谢尔曼反垄断法》（26 Stat. 209；《美国法典》第15编第1至7条）是美国的一部反垄断法律，旨在维护商业竞争并禁止不公平垄断。该法于1890年由国会通过，以主要起草人、参议员约翰·谢尔曼命名。它主要禁止限制竞争的协议，以及垄断或企图垄断相关市场的单方行为。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Finland on 1 and 2 July 1936. Following the election Prime Minister Toivo Mikael Kivimäki of the National Progressive Party was defeated in a confidence vote in September 1936 and resigned in October. Kyösti Kallio of the Agrarian League formed a centrist minority government after Pehr Evind Svinhufvud (National Coalition Party) refused to allow the Social Democrats to join the government. After Svinhufvud's defeat in the February 1937 presidential election, Kallio took office as the new President in March 1937, and he allowed the Social Democrats, Agrarians and Progressives to form the first centre-left or "red soil" ("red" for the Social Democrats and "soil" for the Agrarians) Finnish government.

en.s: Operation Jaque (Spanish: Operación Jaque) was a Colombian military operation that resulted in the successful rescue of 15 hostages, including former Colombian presidential candidate Íngrid Betancourt. The hostages had been held by the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC). The operation took place on July 2, 2008, along the Apaporis River in the department of Guaviare. The other hostages freed were Marc Gonsalves, Thomas Howes, and Keith Stansell, three American military contractors employed by Northrop Grumman and 11 Colombian military and police. Two FARC members were arrested. The operation's name was derived from the Spanish term for a check in chess.

en.s: The 2016 Australian federal election in the Senate was part of a double dissolution election held on Saturday 2 July to elect all 226 members of the 45th Parliament of Australia, after an extended eight-week official campaign period. It was the first double dissolution election since the 1987 election and the first under a new voting system for the Senate that replaced group voting tickets with optional preferential voting.

en.t: Results of the 2016 Australian federal election in New South Wales
en.s: This is a list of electoral division results for the 2016 Australian federal election in the state of New South Wales. This election was held using instant-runoff voting. In two NSW electorates, the winner did not receive the most first preference votes: Labor won the seat of Macquarie despite the Liberals having more first preference votes, and the seat of Richmond despite the Nationals having more first preference votes.

en.s: The July 2016 Dhaka attack or Holey Artisan terrorist attack took place on the night of 1 July 2016, at 21:20 Bangladesh Standard Time (UTC+06:00), when five Islamic State (IS) terrorists took hostages and opened fire on the Holey Artisan Bakery in Gulshan Thana jurisdiction in Dhaka, Bangladesh. The terrorists entered the bakery with crude bombs, machetes, and pistols, and took several dozen hostages, including foreign nationals.

en.s: Prefectural elections for the Tokyo Metropolitan Assembly (平成29年/2017年東京都議会議員選挙, Heisei 29-nen/2017-nen Tōkyō togikai giin senkyo, "Heisei 29/2017 election of members of the Tokyo Metropolitan Assembly") were held on 2 July 2017. The 127 members were elected in forty-two electoral districts, seven returning single members elected by first-past-the-post, and thirty-five returning multiple members under single non-transferable vote. Four districts had their magnitude adjusted in this election to match population changes.

zh.s: 东京都议会选举（平成29年／2017年东京都议会议员选举）于2017年7月2日举行。127名议员从42个选区选出：7个单议席选区采用简单多数制，35个多议席选区采用单记非让渡投票制。此次选举调整了4个选区的议席数，以反映人口变化。

en.s: The Chilean presidential primaries of 2017 were held in Chile on Sunday 2 July 2017. It was the first election in the country's history in which Chileans were permitted to vote from abroad. According to the law, primaries are voluntary, but its results are binding. Two political coalitions decided to participate: Former president Sebastián Piñera won the Chile Vamos primary with 58% of the vote, while radio and television journalist Beatriz Sánchez became the Broad Front nominee with nearly 68%.

zh.s: 2017年智利总统初选于7月2日（星期日）举行。这是智利历史上首次允许海外智利人投票的选举。根据法律，初选为自愿投票，但结果具有约束力。两个政治联盟决定参加：前总统塞巴斯蒂安·皮涅拉以58%的得票率赢得“智利前进”联盟初选；广播和电视记者贝娅特丽丝·桑切斯则以近68%的得票率成为“广泛阵线”提名人。

en.s: The 2017 Leinster Senior Hurling Championship final, the deciding game of the 2017 Leinster Senior Hurling Championship, was a hurling match which was played on 2 July 2017 at Croke Park, Dublin. It was contested by Wexford and Galway, the first ever Leinster final between the two counties. Galway captained by David Burke won the game on a 0–29 to 1–17 scoreline to secure their second Leinster title, they had a 0–14 to 0–11 lead at half-time.

zh.s: 2017年伦斯特高级板棍球锦标赛决赛是该届赛事的冠军决胜赛，于2017年7月2日在都柏林克罗克公园举行。韦克斯福德郡和戈尔韦郡首次在伦斯特决赛中交锋。由戴维·伯克担任队长的戈尔韦以0比29对1比17获胜，拿下队史第二个伦斯特冠军；半场时他们以0比14领先0比11。

It was the thirteenth event under the Slammiversary chronology and celebrates the fifteenth anniversary of the promotion. It was also the first PPV event to be held under the Impact Wrestling name.

en.s: The 2017 FIFA Confederations Cup final was a football match to determine the winners of the 2017 FIFA Confederations Cup, the 10th and last edition of the FIFA Confederations Cup, a quadrennial international men's football tournament organised by FIFA. The match was held at the Krestovsky Stadium in Saint Petersburg, Russia, on 2 July 2017, and was contested by the winners of the semi-finals, Chile and Germany.

en.s: A by-election for the seat of Bragg in the South Australian House of Assembly was held on 2 July 2022. The by-election was triggered by the parliamentary resignation of Liberal Party MP and former Deputy Premier Vickie Chapman on 31 May 2022. Jack Batty retained the seat for the Liberal Party, despite a modest swing being recorded against the party.

en.s: The Battle of Lashio was an offensive conducted by the Three Brotherhood Alliance, along with other anti-junta resistance forces, to capture the northern Shan city of Lashio during the Myanmar civil war.
